body.title: Wire qualification cancellation, evidence and containing budgets
body.summary: Update scripts/qualify-runtime-foundation.mjs to select outer role before allocation, record profile/resolved role caps at evidence start and connect outer work expiry to its AbortController across independent/in-process preparation. Update runtime-foundation-only .github/workflows/ci.yml profile selection and containment240min normal/360min slow; retain backend20min behavior. Add proposed scripts/qualification-containment.mjs with focused proposed scripts/__tests__/qualification-containment.test.ts for shared finite admission checks, and document the local detached supervisor envelope in docs/testing.md. Bound setup/preflight and refuse native admission with insufficient remaining allowance. Do not dispatch Windows job.
acceptanceChecks: Invalid selector fails before fresh home/lease allocation; evidence records selected role values without certifying success.
Outer expiry and explicit cancellation reach independently owned worker/in-process packaging, with cascading bounded cleanup; timers/listeners dispose on all exits.
Hosted slow profile fits360min: preflight work<=40min plus setup/drain<=5min; native5h plus cascade<=7min; remaining diagnostic headroom. Admission refuses insufficient remaining time.

Normal runtime-foundation job contains existing2h native budget; backend workflow behavior is unchanged. Local supervisor covers selected5h work plus drain/diagnostics, with no hidden60/90/120min wrapper.
Use owned coordinator for preflight; selected-test run/file caps are reconciled with enclosing allowance; Windows ownership prerequisite remains separate, no native dispatch.
After t2-t4 wiring, prove actual installed/bundled consumers receive copied policy bytes and preserve import boundaries; avoid a generic supervisor framework.
